prayerExcerpt.en-US: Nothing is so strong as gentleness; nothing so gentle as real strength.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Nada é tão forte quanto a mansidão; nada tão manso quanto a verdadeira força.

meta.face: A sturdy man of about fifty, almost completely bald with a broad full forehead, high arched brows, clear blue eyes, ruddy cheeks, a thick auburn beard of medium length and a gentle, kindly expression.
meta.basis: His nephew Charles-Auguste de Sales's 1634 description (almost completely bald, auburn hair, blue eyes, ruddy cheeks, a thick beard of medium length), which matches the portraits.

sources.title: Chambelland, St. Francis de Sales and His Portraits (DeSales University)
